description.value:
A frame that shimmers with silver threads, radiating a thermal aura. Choose cold or hot siccatite when installed.

Radiant Shield (2 PP): As a reaction, gain +2 to EAC and KAC. Attackers take tier damage (cold or fire based on type).

Thermal Burst (1 PP): Deal 6d8 cold or fire damage in an 80-foot radius (Reflex save DC 15 + mech tier for half).

A mech can have only one starmetal frame system.
